QuestInfo.name: The Puppeteer's Invitation
QuestInfo.0: A mysterious figure starts talking to you...
QuestInfo.1: When you accept the invitation from the mysterious figure, you find yourself in front of a strange-looking cave! Inside the cave... there is a kid with the puppets! Is this kid responsible for manipulating the monsters in #m100000000#? Talk to the kid.

1.0: Hmmm? I still haven't found a suitable Informant Assignment for you... well, do you need me for anything else? Or do you have some juicy information for me...?\n#b#L0#(You tell him about your encounter with Francis the Puppeteer.)#l\n#k
1.1: #p1204001#, the Puppeteer for the Black Wings, you say? It all makes sense now... The Puppeteer must be the one behind the strange behavior of the #o1210102# monsters at #m100000000# and the feral nature of the #o5130101# monsters. But... Did he really mention the Black Mage?
